purpose: Define recovery from partial/interrupted upgrade using exact recorded completed stages, target state, idempotency and compatibility evidence.

owns: Interrupted Upgrade Resume and Recovery semantics

topics.name: Interrupted Upgrade Resume and Recovery
topics.purpose: Define recovery from partial/interrupted upgrade using exact recorded completed stages, target state, idempotency and compatibility evidence.

semantics.execution_rule: Resume references exact interrupted deployment/upgrade execution.
semantics.state_rule: Completed/pending/failed migration and rollout stages are explicit.
semantics.target_rule: Current actual artifact/config/schema state is re-read and verified.
semantics.resume_rule: Only safe pending/idempotent steps may resume.
semantics.unknown_rule: Ambiguous current state blocks automated resume.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: resume assumes last log line succeeded
